subtitle: REAL TOWNS / SHORTENED ROADS
name: Lower Veronese plain
description: Cerea, Legnago, Bovolone, Sanguinetto, Nogara and Casaleone at real scale, joined by their real main roads through the villages between them, shortened so neighbouring towns are a few minutes apart.

mission.name: Lower Veronese plain taxi shift
mission.objective: Work a taxi shift from 07:00 to 17:00 across six towns. Collect passengers and earn fares.
mission.hint: Stop and request fares when you want a passenger.

provenance.source: OpenStreetMap / Overpass API: town extracts and the region's main roads
notes: Towns keep their real streets at real scale; the real main roads between them are shortened by k, keeping their junctions, one-way tags and names.
Direction boards between towns show real road distances.
Designated stopping bays are gameplay placements, not verified real parking permissions.

provenance.source: OpenStreetMap / Overpass API: town extracts and the region's main roads
provenance.licence: OSM-derived database content: ODbL-1.0; no separate licence assigned to original game content
provenance.synthetic: Towns are real at real scale; the real main roads between them are shortened (corridor compression). Stopping bays, signs and props are game placements.
